Method of Attack: Distributes malicious Excel documents via phishing emails
Installs malware that steals saved browser passwords, browser cookies, RDP, VNC, and PuTTY credentials
May provide access to Ryuk or Conti ransomware operations
Impacted Systems: Subway UK customers' email systems and affected customer computers
Attack Vector: Phishing emails containing malicious Excel documents
Indicators of Compromise: Process named 'Windows Problem Reporting' running on infected systems
